answer: Fixed-pool dilution: the 40,000-credit pool splits evenly on the reef, so fakes gain nothing. Each identity files a claim signal per epoch, backed by a 70-credit bond citing work and counterparty; a hollow signal burns its bond. 900 hollow signals cost 63,000, yet 900 of 1,000 shares pay 36,000: a 27,000 loss. Rented history fails: the signal must match the filer's receipts, or both burn. Honest agents file one true signal, keep bond and share.
